bio: Located about 5km southeast of Cervera, this restaurant is striking for its setting in an historic farm boasting large stone archways that was once the granary for the Montserrat monastery and the occasional residence of its abbot. The updated take on traditional Catalan cuisine (choose between the à la carte and an “executive” menu), is based around top-quality ingredients, many of which are, where possible, sourced locally. Els Comdals is also popular with groups and as an event venue....
